target_pdb.description: Absolute path to the target structure (PDB or CIF).

target_chain.description: Chain ID of the target on the target_pdb.

mode.description: Runtime mode. 'infer' (default) runs diffusion-only in-process and emits backbone-only outputs with sequence unavailable. 'pipeline' uses a persistent sidecar in the dedicated `pxdesign-pipeline-vpa` conda env to run AF2-IG initial guess + ProteinMPNN sequence design + filtering and produce real designed amino-acid sequences.

top_k_designs.description: Pipeline mode only: number of top filtered designs to return.

mpnn_temperature.description: Pipeline mode only: ProteinMPNN sampling temperature.

af2_init_guess.description: Pipeline mode only: enable AF2 initial-guess co-folding for sequence filtering.

preset.description: Pipeline mode only: PXDesign upstream preset. 'preview' is AF2-only (lighter, faster); 'extended' adds Protenix ranking. Overrides the af2_init_guess shortcut when set explicitly.
